metadata.name: MDESPushProvisioning
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to provide TAV data which is required for Push Provisioning a card into wallets.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: WalletApplication
request_fields.description: This value identifies the type of Wallet Valid Values: 01=Google 02=Samsung 03=Apple Example:01 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: TavVersionNumber
request_fields.description: TAV Format Valid Values:3 Format:X Example:3 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: DataValidUntilTimestamp
request_fields.description: ISO 8601 format of the date and time(with Time Zone) the TAV expires and will no longer be honored Valid Values:0-9 Allowable Values: 29

request_fields.name: PANUniqueReference
request_fields.description: PAN Unique Reference associated with the token Valid Values:0-9 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: TokenUniqueReference
request_fields.description: Token Unique Reference associated with the token. Valid Values:0-9 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: FinancialAccountInformation
request_fields.description: Identifier of the financial account being tokenized Valid Values:0-9 Allowable Values: 78

request_fields.name: AccountExpiry
request_fields.description: Expiration Year and month of PAN as required with communication with MasterCard for Push Provisioning Valid Values: 0-9 Format:MMYY Example:0822 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: CardholderName
request_fields.description: Name of the Card holder Example: John Joe Condition: Name of the cardholder in the format lastname/firstname or firstname lastname. Allowable Values: 27

request_fields.name: BillingAddress
request_fields.description: BillingAddress

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Card holder's address line 1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example: 123 HWY Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Card holder's address line 2 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example: Park Avenue Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Card holder's City Valid Values:A-Z Example: Los Angeles Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CountrySubdivision
request_fields.description: Country subdivision of billing address Valid Values:A-Z Example: US Allowable Values: 12

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal code of the card holder's address. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 46206 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Address Country of the Card Holder Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.1 for Country Name Codes Example: US Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption
request_fields.description: Encrypts sensitive cardholder and device information using Apple-specified encryption standards. This ensures the payload can only be decrypted and processed by Apple, maintaining end-to-end security. Example: 01 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: Nonce
request_fields.description: In Apple Pay, the Nonce is generated by the device and included in the tokenization request to verify that the request is new and has not been reused. Condition: WalletApplication = 03 and RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption = 01 Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: NonceSignature
request_fields.description: It ensures the integrity and authenticity of the Nonce, proving it was generated by a legitimate, trusted device and has not been tampered with. Condition: WalletApplication = 03 and RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption = 01 Allowable Values: 512

request_fields.name: LeafCertificate
request_fields.description: Used to verify the authenticity of the NonceSignature, ensuring it originated from a valid Apple device. Condition: WalletApplication = 03 and RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption = 01 Allowable Values: 4000

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: CardInfo
children.description: Required when The EphemeralPublicKey is a temporary public key used in Apple Pay's secure end-to-end encryption process during token provisioning. Returned when WalletApplication = 01 or 02 or 03 and RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption = 01 Allowable Values: 8000

children.name: EphemeralPublicKey
children.description: The EphemeralPublicKey is a temporary public key used in Apple Pay's secure end-to-end encryption process during token provisioning. Returned when WalletApplication = 03 and RequiredApplePaySpecificEncryption = 01
